item.description:
One name for card, tab and Claude session; Board AI chat queue

  • Board AI: a card, its tab and its Claude Code session now share one name. When you or the Board AI chat rename a card, the name goes to its workspace tab or task tab, and then to its Claude session at your next message. This also works when a workspace has more than one card.
  • Board AI: Claude sessions that were already running also take the new name at your next message. You do not need to restart them.
  • Board AI: when you rename a Claude session with /rename, its tab and card take that name. A name you typed always beats an AI name. Switch: Settings › Board AI › Keep agent session names in sync (on by default). Codex and Cursor sessions are not renamed yet.
  • Board AI: names are short, 1 to 4 words. Older card names that stayed only on the card now go to the workspace tab once.
  • Board AI chat: a message you send while Board AI is answering waits in a queue, shown as Queued, with an x to remove it. Earlier messages are never replaced. Stop puts the queued messages back in the input box. The chat scrolls down only when you are at the bottom or you send.
  • Claude Code: the permission prompts panel is on by default again. Switch it off in Settings › Claude Code or in Command-P.
